metadata.Name: WikiOmnia
metadata.Description: WikiOmnia is a large QA dataset for Russian, generated automatically from Russian Wikipedia summaries. It includes QA pairs generated by ruGPT-3 XL and ruT5-large models, with a filtration pipeline to ensure quality.
metadata.Paper Title: WikiOmnia: filtration and evaluation of the generated QA corpus on the whole Russian Wikipedia
metadata.Abstract: We present WikiOmnia, the largest QA dataset for Russian, obtained in a fully automated way. The dataset contains QA pairs for every article of Russian Wikipedia, based on the summary sections. WikiOmnia consists of 2 parts: the voluminous, automatically generated part (15.9 million triplets) and the filtered part (3.5 million triplets, fully verified with automatic means). Apart from the data, we present a fully-automated pipeline for SQuAD-like data generation for Russian, based on generative part represented by the ruGPT-3 XL and ruT5-large models, and filtering part that includes Russian BERT baseline and rich heuristic approach. All stated models were fine-tuned on SberQuAD that is based on the methodology of the original English SQuAD. The whole automated and unsupervised generation and filtration pipeline was also tested for creating SQuAD-formatted QA on other domains: news texts, customer reviews, fiction, and social media.
